# AI-Ques hardening memory

- Freeze feature/mode expansion until current P0/P1 findings are reduced.
- Current Chinese PCL-5 and CAPE-P15 text is prototype wording; do not call it a validated baseline.
- Future Me is a reflective lab, not an assessment condition.
- Future Me narrative/chat data is sensitive user-authored content: disclose browser persistence and escape all dynamic rendering.
- Prefer small changes with a visible research or safety rationale over broad refactors.
- P2 scope changes such as moving Future Me require explicit human approval; the controller must report them rather than auto-actuate them.
